notes.title: New unlock for those ninjas who 100% the game
notes.content:
Hey guys,
I've uploaded an update which includes an extra unlock for those of you who manage to get a 100% completion score in Systematic Immunity. I thought such a feat of prowess deserves something a bit more special, so you now get a ninja suit for your main cell when you 100% the game!
The update also includes a slight change to the camera controls in the level editor. From now on to move the camera simply hold the "M" key and move the mouse. This should make adding larger objects a lot easier.

Thanks guys.
Enjoy :)

notes.title: White Blood Cell Winner: Systematic Immunity
notes.content:
Way back on April 17, 2013, John gave Plasma Being developer Felix Wunderlich his Today’s Best Name award. Today, I’m putting him forward again for June 6th’s prize, but I’m also going to talk about his newly-released latest project – Systematic Immunity [official site]. Like its forerunner, it’s a quirky puzzle-platformer, however this one sees you take charge of a group of white blood cells who’re battling a “nasty bugger of a germ.” Trailers are the best cure for such an ailment, or so I’ve heard:

… [visit site to read more]
